alt: Minus the one-day 99% value at risk of the TAIEX total-return index forecast by historical simulation, GARCH with t innovations and the normal model, January 2008 to October 2026, with the returns of the exceedance days of the first two as points: the forecasts widen after each crash, and on 7 April 2025 the index fell 9.70% against forecasts of 3.53%, 4.14% and 2.66%
